nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Enzyme Powder Wash

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the wash reduces oil production without stripping and states it works for all skin types.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cleanser removes dirt and makeup without stripping, leaving skin hydrated and soft, though a couple note mild drying with daily use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report no dryness or tightness, though one with combo skin experienced burning on active pimples.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and a gentle feel, but several flag the scent as a concern and one found it too strong for her sensitive skin.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin report brighter, more even tone and a moisturized after-feel.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports her mature skin felt amazing and smooth after use.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer (46) reports skin feeling amazing and smooth; another links the product to skin feeling youthful, but no reviewer discusses fine lines or firmness specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft, or moisturized rather than dry; a few dissent, describing dryness or tightness with daily use, especially those with dry or sensitive skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer explicitly reports no redness or issues; another with sensitive skin found the fragrance risked irritation, though no one reports lasting redness from use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the AHAs irritated her skin barrier when she used too much product, resolved by reducing the amount used.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a brighter, more even skin tone or reduced unevenness over one to two weeks of use; a few report no visible change in tone or brightness at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, with one noting reduced breakouts even under stress; however, one reviewer with combination skin reports burning on existing pimples.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports reduced oil production after use; another reviewer describes the wash acting more as an oil-stripper rather than moisturizing for her skin.

aspects.libelle: Smooth, soft skin texture after use

extraits.texte: i liked this product but i don't feel that it gave me any results - my skin felt clean but not any brighter/more even. I would love for there to be an unscented version - the smell was a little strong especially for my sensitive skin

I have really been getting into Korean skin care lately and was excited to have the opportunity to try this product. I love the tatcha rice polish but hate the price and this product is almost identical to it! I used way too much when I first tried and the powerful AHAs irritated my skin barrier so going forward you only need a little bit of the rice powder to get a great physical exfoliation. My skin was super soft after the application and I will enjoy using this product in my skin care regimen!

Its a good concept with the powder and then adding water but its not something i would use everyday. I use Cerave as I have combo skin and i felt some burning on some new pimples I had. Overall it might be great for others just not my skin.

extraits.titre: Might be my new favorite face wash
extraits.texte: I'll be honest, I didn't expect much from this wash because of how cutesy the packaging was but wow was I wrong. From the very first wash my skin immediately looked brighter and glowy - my friends have even commented on it! For reference I'm 32 with normal skin on the dry side. So my skin can be temperamental and is prone to flaring up when I try new products or layer acids, of which I used several in my (extensive) skincare routine, this caused no issues even with the acidity. I loved the texture of this cleanser and that it didn't cause a mess to use. I just wet both hands before getting a "serving" of the face wash powder and that's enough moisture to get a full and luxurious lather. I swear there's also a bit of a scrubby feeling - it's subtle but feels SO good. I also have to commend the thoughtful product design. I've used powder cleaners/exfoliants before and they can be so messy. But the way the opening is designed it limits how much comes out at once and you get the perfect amount of cleanser each time. Overall, I'm a total product junkie — especially K-beauty — and was genuinely impressed by this face cleanser. I've tried foaming cleansers from Toboco (very disappointing), Round Lab (super moisturizing), skin1004 (solid), Farmacy (bleh), Laniege (my current main), Good Molecules, fresh, acure, sulwasoo and this one is easily one of my new faves! It's not as moisturizing as Round Lab but I think it does a more thorough job so it balances out.

extraits.titre: I would buy the enzyme powder face wash over and over again!
extraits.texte: Thank you the face shop, clean beauty for the free product! The enzyme powder wash is a great product due to its ability to break down dead skin without harsh scrubbing. This product also is a gentle wash and doesn't irritate the skin. The powder wash leaves a moisturizing finish. This product is different from others because it leaves my face smooth without feeling dry. I would recommend this product because I have oily skin and it reduces the amount of oils produced and it works for all skin types!

I loved this!! I have super dry skin and this cleansed really well, while still keeping my face feeling hydrated. I'd never used a powder cleanser before, but I really liked it. It easily turns to a lather once you add water. Makes it easy to travel with as well!! I would definitely recommend this and will likely be repurchasing. *I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.*

extraits.titre: Clean but can be a little drying
extraits.texte: This is my first time using a powder cleanser and honestly, it's pretty cool. I like how you can control exactly how much you use each time. I've been using it daily and it cleans really well, but I did notice it can be a bit drying, so I probably wouldn't use it more than once a day. I also like that it doesn't really have a scent and it doesn't sting my eyes either, which is a big plus.
